zakat.metaTitle: Zakat calculator: work out zakat from your assets and nisab
zakat.metaDescription: Work out your zakat (2.5%) from cash, gold, silver and investments minus short-term debts. Enter today's nisab yourself; nothing you type is stored.
zakat.nisabHint: Nisab = today's market value of 87.48 g of gold or 612.36 g of silver. Check today's local price and enter it in taka; the app assumes no price.
zakat.step2: 2) Net zakatable = Total assets - Short-term debts
zakat.step3: 3) If net zakatable is above nisab, zakat due = net × 2.5%
zakat.eligibleDueNow: Your wealth is above nisab. Estimated zakat: {amount}
zakat.belowNisabDue: Your wealth is below nisab, so no zakat is due on this estimate ({amount}).
zakat.nisabNeeded: Enter the nisab value to see whether zakat is due and how much.
zakat.rule1: This is an estimate tool; consult a qualified scholar for personal rulings.
zakat.rule2: Zakat is generally due when wealth stays above Nisab for one lunar year (hawl).
zakat.rule3: Nisab value changes with gold/silver prices; set your local Nisab value accordingly.
zakat.rule4: Only zakatable assets and payable short-term debts should be entered.
